---
title: "Chromosomal distribution of Drosophila pseudoobscura putative sperm proteins"
output: html_notebook
---
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(readxl)

list <- read_excel("~/PMR/ZLY_Workspace/02. Workspace/01. Male_tissues_proteins/density/01.Protein_distribution_on_Chr.xlsx")
list
```
```{r}
df_clean <- list %>%
  dplyr::filter(Chr != "mito") %>% 
  mutate(Chr_Group = case_when(
    Chr == "AX" ~ "AX",
    Chr == "DX" ~ "DX",
    Chr %in% c("2", "3", "4") ~ Chr, # 2, 3, 4 分开
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )) %>%
  filter(Chr_Group != "Other")

df_clean$Chr_Group <- factor(df_clean$Chr_Group, 
                             levels = c("AX", "DX", "2", "3", "4"))

global_sperm_prob <- sum(df_clean$Catogory == "sperm") / nrow(df_clean)
global_non_prob <- 1 - global_sperm_prob
global_probs <- c(global_sperm_prob, global_non_prob)

stats_table <- df_clean %>%
  group_by(Chr_Group) %>%
  summarise(
    Observed_Sperm = sum(Catogory == "sperm"),
    Observed_Non = sum(Catogory == "non-sperm"),
    Total = n()
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Expected_Sperm = Total * global_sperm_prob,
    OE_Ratio = Observed_Sperm / Expected_Sperm
  )
stats_table
```
```{r}
run_chisq_gof <- function(target_chr) {
  data <- stats_table %>% dplyr::filter(Chr_Group == target_chr)
  obs_counts <- c(data$Observed_Sperm, data$Observed_Non)
  res <- chisq.test(x = obs_counts, p = global_probs)
  return(list(
    Chi_Sq = as.numeric(res$statistic),
    P_val = res$p.value
  ))
}

chisq_results <- map_dfr(stats_table$Chr_Group, run_chisq_gof)

stats_table <- stats_table %>%
  select(-any_of(c("Chi_Sq_Stat", "P_val", "P_adj"))) %>% # 防止重复
  bind_cols(chisq_results) %>%
  mutate(P_adj = p.adjust(P_val, method = "BH"))

stats_table <- stats_table %>%
  mutate(
    Combined_Label = case_when(
      P_adj < 0.05 ~ sprintf("X^2 = %.1f\nq = %.3f", Chi_Sq, P_adj),
      TRUE ~ sprintf("X^2 = %.1f\nq = %.3f", Chi_Sq, P_adj) # 如果想全标的话
    )
  )

p <- ggplot(stats_table, aes(x = Chr_Group, y = OE_Ratio, fill = Chr_Group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", width = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Combined_Label, y = OE_Ratio + 0.06), 
            vjust = 0, size = 4, fontface = "italic") + 
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(Observed_Sperm, "/", round(Expected_Sperm, 0)), y = 0.05), 
            vjust = 0, size = 4, color = "white", fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "AX" = "#AA5440", "DX" = "#385B6F", 
    "2" = "#5A9E6F", "3" = "#905998", "4" = "#EBC855"
  )) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.25))) + 
  labs(
    title = "Sperm Protein Enrichment vs. Null Expectation",
    y = "Observed / Expected no. genes",
    x = "Chromosome"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, color = "black")
  )

print(p)
```
